g.text: The text layer of a split page: why it was half the page wide, and the fix (docs/scientific/12 §4.1)
: CSS px per point at the current zoom
the shown half: its corner at
: where a run in the layer's root starts, in percent of the page (its style left: L%)
before: the constructor's size is the last one written
(offset-layer!: the shown half's corner at the sheet's)
height: the same with the page height and var(--scale-round-y)
render(): each run in the layer's root at left: L%, top: T%
--scale-round-x and -y are defined only by pdf_viewer.css,
which the app does not load
width and height compute to auto
the layer is half the page wide, and a run
so find's highlights and the selection miss the words
the fix: the engine writes the size again, after the constructor
render(): runs at left: L%, top: T%
for every page and every half
of the page, under the slide's own word
the renderer: the PDF engine, pdf.js, the layer's style, Chromium's style and layout
